acceptance_criteria.statement: Choosing Approve records an approved decision.
Choosing Request changes records a changes-requested decision.
The recorded decision identifies its author.
A reviewer can replace an earlier decision with a later decision without erasing its history.

content.statement: As a developer reviewing a change, I can approve it or request changes so my review decision is explicit.
content.title: Record a review decision
